objects.original: One real ordered tensor degree component: F_i,p=sqrt(n)*a_i,p*<Xi_i,p,psi_i^tensor p>, with psi_i containing K^j copies of u_(i+j).
objects.reconstructed: The literal finite sum sqrt(n)*a*sum_c xi(c)*product_(r,j,k) u(j)(c(r,j,k)); c ranges over all functions from p repeated tensor blocks to Fin n.
objects.evidence: Read the actual definition body, not just its name. TensorSlots=Fin p x Sigma(j:Fin(h-i+1)),Fin(K^j). Thus |slots|=p*sum_j K^j and |coordinates|=n^(p*S_i). Each direction occurs p*K^j times. Coordinates are not quotiented or symmetrized. The source defines the pairing entrywise; no factorial or normalized symmetrization appears in either expression.

domains.original: The paper uses a product of unit spheres, sufficiently large n, and h=floor((log n)^(1/3)/32). The pinned review contract explicitly declares the deterministic polynomial extension to arbitrary real directions and all positive n/natural h.
domains.reconstructed: n:PNat, h:Nat, i:Fin(h+1); even 4<=p<=2^(64*(h+1)); u is an unrestricted trailing tuple in real Euclidean n-space and xi an arbitrary coefficient array.
domains.evidence: Equivalence here is to the explicitly extended, isolated definition contract and to the source after restriction; it is NOT equality of the unqualified paper and Lean domains. The body agrees on unit tuples and has a literal polynomial extension off them, not an if/default branch. i<h+1 implies i<=h, so natural subtraction has no accidental truncation. Generalizations are separately recorded below.

quantifiers.original: For each permitted i,p, the source component can be evaluated on any unit trailing tuple and coefficient realization; the review contract additionally permits arbitrary directions.
quantifiers.reconstructed: A function uniformly in every n,h,i,p,u,xi in the displayed types; Lean u(j) denotes source u_(i+j).
quantifiers.evidence: The shift j=0,...,h-i accounts for precisely the trailing tuple. No leading directions enter the product. Arbitrary xi is appropriate for defining the function, before assigning any measure.

assumptions.original: The scoped definition contract retains positive dimension, natural depth, 0<=i<=h and even degree in [4,P]. It asserts neither unit-feature normalization off sphere nor a Gaussian law.
assumptions.reconstructed: Exactly these discrete constraints are in the types; no norm assumption, probability measure, integrability premise, or pre-supplied law is present.
assumptions.evidence: The source sphere restriction is explicitly distinguished from the extended deterministic definition. p.property keeps both bounds and parity. The coefficient distribution belongs to the separate theorem, not a hidden premise in this definition.

conclusion.original: Construct the literal scalar angular degree polynomial with the Eq. (14) amplitude and Eq. (15) entrywise pairing.
conclusion.reconstructed: A noncomputable real-valued definition, not an assertion of a law, inequality, or existence theorem.
conclusion.evidence: The sum and product in the actual body realize the full tensor contraction. No conditional fallback, chosen witness, axiomatic object, or substituted simplified component occurs.

scopes.original: This review targets only one degree component. The paper also constructs a degree-summed field and a joint independent coefficient family, outside the isolated contract.
scopes.reconstructed: One deterministic component is constructed; no degree sum, joint randomness, radial cutoff, gate, conditioning or sampling lower bound is claimed.
scopes.evidence: Module documentation and lesson both expose these exclusions. The definition lesson correctly calls this a construction and leaves the Gaussian law to the adjacent theorem.

constant_dependencies.reconstructed: The same constants are literal expressions, with finite-index sums and explicit real coercions; the component is multiplied by sqrt(n)*a.
constant_dependencies.evidence: Checked 74,64,degree power 4,S power 2, factor 2, logarithm argument, depth factor and square root against primary Eq. (14). Natural/real powers agree after coercion. The j=0 term gives S>=1, p>=4 and h-i+1>=1; hence the logarithm and denominator are positive. The focused test proves this universally, so totalized division is not masking a zero denominator.

deltas.description: The raw paper fixes sufficiently large n and its prescribed h; Lean allows every positive n and natural h. This is an explicitly disclosed extension of the isolated component, not an extension of hard-family admissibility.

The paper defines F_i,p on unit-sphere tuples; Lean defines its same polynomial on all real direction tuples. This is explicit in the packet and lesson. Restriction matches the source; no off-sphere unit norm or variance claim is made.

A tensor coordinate is represented by a function assigning an entry to each ordered slot rather than a flattened numerical index. This preserves all n^(p*S_i) independent coefficient coordinates and multiplicities.
The degree sum and independent family appearing alongside Eq. (15) are excluded from this exact one-degree review. The definition itself carries no probabilistic theorem credit.

verdict_scope: Accepted for the explicitly declared isolated polynomial extension and its agreement with the paper on the paper's domain. This does not assert unqualified domain equality with the full source construction.
